description: 국가철도공단 대전교통공사 공기호흡기 [railways and stations] (series on Public Data Portal (data.go.kr)) is a series of datasets listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. -지하철에 비치된 양압식 공기호흡기 사용법! 1. 공기호흡기를 메고 몸에 맞게 조절하세요.. 2. 면체를 쓰고 얼굴에 밀착하세요. 3. Coverage: South Korea. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 도시광역철도, 호흡기, 대전지하철, 노선명, 역명. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
